Subject: CAIQ priority stub index and evidence inventory request

Hi team and Anna —

Quick summary from my review of Greenline's CAIQ: there are ~18 controls where the customer is specifically asking for runtime or tenant-scoped proof (log samples, KV/response traces, keystore attestations). To keep the intake manageable for legal and security, I want us to produce a single "priority-stub-index.csv" that maps each CAIQ question to: control_id, short ask, evidence type (artifact vs. runtime sample), owner, and planned delivery date.

Ask list:
- Marissa: can you compile the artifact list (arch diagrams, keystore proof, config snapshots) and confirm owners?
- Jonas: can you provide a suggested sampling approach for runtime traces (KV cache, prefix cache, inference telemetry) so we can redact PII before sharing?
- Priya: help me confirm whether any of the items need export controls/third-party approvals before we hand them off to Greenline security.

Attachments I plan to drop in the Drive folder: priority-stub-index.csv (starter), arch-diagram.png (redacted), and a placeholder for runtime-log-sample.zip (we'll stage once sampling is agreed). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gf-CAIQ-Greenline-evidence

Timeline: customer asked for a first pass by 2025-06-25. Can we target an internal draft by EOD 2025-06-23? If not, call out blockers and new dates.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:30:22 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ priority stub index and evidence inventory request

Kim / Marissa —

Good notes. A few technical constraints and a proposed sampling plan:

1) KV/cache traces: we can emit a 24-hour rolling extract that contains ops per tenant and request latency buckets, but we must strip prompt/response payloads. I suggest a two-stage scrub: token-level redaction (truncate payloads to 32 bytes) + hashing of identifiers.

2) Inference telemetry: aggregate-level metrics are fine (latency, error rate, model-version). For question-level controls that demand "proof of segregation" we can provide a time-windowed trace showing tenant affinitized worker IDs without request bodies.

3) Audit logs / keystore: we can provide redacted audit exports and a signed attestation for KMS usage. Note some key rotation logs are in the HSM vendor portal — that will require a vendor statement or an export we sign.

I attached a short sampling plan (sampling-plan-2025-06-19.pdf) with proposed schema for runtime-log-sample.zip. If legal/security okays the redaction approach we can produce a zipped sample for Greenline's review by 2025-06-24.


> On Wed, Jun 18, 2025 at 11:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> > I'll take the artifact list...

Jonas Weber
Principal Reliability Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
